T0530.title: Quota Control
T0530.definition: A policy that limits total resource consumption such as calls, transactions, inventory, credits, or compute usage.
T0530.description: Quota control limits total resource consumption over a period, such as daily API calls, inventory claims, account limits, coupon use, or compute usage. It is useful for low-frequency but persistent abuse and for capping maximum loss per identity or tenant. Designs should define metering scope, reset period, and shared-quota boundaries.
T0530.usageExample: Risk control sets a daily coupon-claim quota control of three per account, after which manual review is triggered, preventing illicit actors from bulk-claiming coupons and reselling them for cash.
